reading.body:
Cohere builds enterprise LLM products optimized for retrieval-augmented generation, with all three tracked offerings emphasizing data privacy and on-premises deployment control rather than scale.

The company's product line reflects a deliberate positioning away from the frontier model race. Command R+, Coral, and the API are each designed for organizations that need language models integrated into existing workflows while retaining control over their data. RAG optimization appears across all three offerings, suggesting Cohere's technical thesis prioritizes grounding models in customer-specific information over raw model capability.

This focus has implications for compute demand. RAG-native systems typically require less raw model scale because retrieval handles factuality and specificity. A customer using Command R+ with grounded data sources may need fewer parameters and less inference compute than a customer relying on a frontier model's internal knowledge. For the grid constraint, this matters: enterprise adoption driven by privacy and data control creates different power profiles than adoption driven by capability.

The data does not cover Cohere's training infrastructure, inference capacity, or actual power consumption. It does not indicate whether the company runs its own data centers or uses cloud providers. It shows what Cohere sells, not the compute or grid requirements behind those products.

profile_text.body:
Cohere, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Toronto, Canada, builds large language models and AI solutions for enterprises. The company describes itself as enabling organizations to automate processes, empower employees, and turn fragmented data into actionable insights. Cohere offers tools for generative AI, advanced search, and multilingual capabilities designed to keep enterprises in full control of their data.

The company's product line includes Cohere Coral, an enterprise chat AI with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities and a focus on data privacy; the Cohere API, an enterprise-focused LLM API optimized for RAG and multi-language support; and Cohere Command R+, an enterprise RAG-optimized model with tool use and autonomous retrieval features. Cohere serves financial services, technology, and energy and utilities sectors, describing applications ranging from risk reduction and customer experience enhancement to infrastructure modernization and cost optimization.
